sources.title: LongCat-2.0 formal release announcement, June 30, 2026
sources.evidence: Announces the final LongCat-2.0 on June 30, distinguishes its earlier preview, and reports 1.6T nominal parameters, average ~48B activated with a 33B–56B dynamic range, native 1M context, ScMoE/zero-compute experts, reasoning and tool use.

sources.title: LongCat-2.0 official model card at audited checkpoint revision
sources.evidence: Identifies the final language model as LongCat-2.0; describes MoE, LongCat Sparse Attention and 135B nominal N-gram embedding parameters, three-step MTP, text chat with thinking on/off and tools, and explicitly licenses the weights under MIT.

sources.title: LongCat-2.0 configuration at 834bf5ffe3047aa9f6cc7a64a9bc068b146b8274
sources.evidence: LongcatCausalLM: 38 layers, hidden size 8192, 768 routed plus 128 zero-compute experts and top-k12, MLA/LSA configuration, three MTP steps with replication, N-gram embedding, max_position_embeddings 262144, and DeepSeek YaRN original 8192/factor 120. No quantization_config is present.

sources.title: LongCat-2.0 full checkpoint index and bounded shard headers
sources.evidence: All 194 revision-pinned safetensors headers were fetched with HTTP 206 bounded ranges; all 88,780 tensor names exactly match the index. Their BF16/F32 shapes sum to 1,775,560,491,136 storage elements and 3,551,699,340,032 bytes. Main namespace: 1,638,616,807,424; MTP namespace: 136,943,683,712. Both contain N-gram embedding tables/projections. No quantization scales or packed integer tensors occur.

sources.title: Official LongCat inference implementation: main model and router
sources.evidence: Defines shortcut MoE decoder blocks, separate token embedding and LM-head modules, skips the MTP namespace when loading the target model, and declares router e_score_correction_bias as an nn.Parameter. In this checkpoint the latter accounts for 34,048 stored entries; an inference Parameter declaration does not establish backpropagation learning semantics.

sources.title: Official LongCat next-token prediction implementation
sources.evidence: MTP loader maps model.mtp.layers.0 to one next-token prediction module, skips separately saved embedding/head weights, and loads the prediction-specific transformations. This supports separating the single stored MTP block from its three speculative decoding steps.

sources.title: Official speculative worker embedding sharing
sources.evidence: init_drafter_embedding retrieves target embeddings/head and passes the same objects to set_oe_and_head or set_embed_and_head. Thus the serving graph can reuse target token/N-gram embeddings; serialized copies must not automatically be treated as distinct learned parameters. The file does not establish equality or training identity of every exported duplicate.

sources.title: LongCat API model parameters
sources.evidence: Exact LongCat-2.0 column specifies 1,048,576 tokens input+output context and 131,072 maximum output tokens. This is the documented hosted service limit, distinct from the downloadable checkpoint default.

sources.title: LongCat API platform change log
sources.evidence: Separately dates LongCat-2.0-Preview to April 20, 2026 and final LongCat-2.0 to June 30, 2026; the final release supports native tool calling and multi-step reasoning. The September 25 entry calls image understanding a new LongCat-2.5-Preview capability.

sources.title: LongCat-2.0 weights and domestic accelerator inference code released
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 announcement says LongCat-2.0 is now open sourced, distinguishing weight availability from the June 30 final model release.

sources.title: Official checkpoint metadata and revision
sources.evidence: Public ungated BF16/F32 checkpoint, created July 5, 2026; audited current revision 834bf5ffe3047aa9f6cc7a64a9bc068b146b8274, modified July8. Safetensors metadata independently matches the header total. Repository creation alone is not the model release date.

sources.title: Official LongCat-2.0 FP8 distribution
sources.evidence: Separate public official FP8 distribution confirmed through repository API, revision d5f32b1aaee4682826d927ec25433da84b281fd0. Its quantized storage is not used to derive this BF16 checkpoint count.

sources.title: Official LongCat-2.0 INT8 distribution
sources.evidence: Separate public official INT8 distribution confirmed through repository API, revision b2c604b34b3580ee542272bd9dccaa316749be93. It is a released precision variant, not a replacement identity for the final model.

sources.title: LongCat Chat Completions API
sources.evidence: Lists the exact LongCat-2.0 identifier, plain-text message input and text/reasoning response schema, and thinking enable/disable control.

name.note: Exact final model name; not LongCat-2.0-Preview, LongCat-2.5-Preview or a Flash-family checkpoint.

developer.note: Released by Meituan and its LongCat team.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family name supported by the developer’s LongCat model series.

release_date.note: Final model/API release was June 30. Earlier preview release was April 20; public repository creation July 5 and announced weight release July 6 are distinct events, so the final-model date is retained.

open_weights.note: Confirmed accessible ungated official weights. Count audit targets the BF16/F32 checkpoint at revision 834bf5ffe3047aa9f6cc7a64a9bc068b146b8274. Official FP8 and INT8 distributions also exist; no separate base versus instruct checkpoint is inferred.

license.note: The developer expressly releases the model weights under MIT; not merely the inference code.

parameters_b.note: Publisher nominal total, not an exact learned-parameter count. Complete header total is 1,775.560491136B stored BF16/F32 elements: main 1,638.616807424B plus MTP 136.943683712B. Each namespace contains 134.978871296B N-gram table elements and 0.067108864B projections; MTP also stores 1.342177280B token embeddings and 0.555526272B prediction-specific elements. The public implementation shares target embeddings/head and uses one MTP block over three steps, but headers cannot establish all exported-copy training identities. Routing correction entries total 0.000034048B and are inference nn.Parameters; they are not silently discarded as learned or nonlearned. No quantization/scales/packed-storage correction applies. Retain explicit nominal 1600B instead of promoting storage totals or a deduplicated serving estimate to a verified learned count.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported approximate average per-token activation, dynamically 33B–56B with zero-compute experts; not total checkpoint storage and not a constant top-k reconstruction. Auxiliary MTP speculative-step cost is not separately included or quantified by the publisher.

architecture.note: Autoregressive Transformer/shortcut MoE with MLA-derived LongCat Sparse Attention, N-gram embeddings and MTP. Configuration has 38 shortcut blocks, each with two attention/dense branches, 768 routed plus 128 zero-compute experts, top-k12; decoder tensor names confirm 76 attention sublayers. Three draft steps use one stored MTP block. No multimodal encoder appears in the complete checkpoint index.

context_window.note: Exact documented hosted API input+output limit 1,048,576, output cap 131,072. Checkpoint config sets max_position_embeddings 262,144 with DeepSeek YaRN original 8192/factor 120; these are configuration/default/extension settings, not proof that an arbitrary local server exposes the API maximum. Publisher says native 1M context training. No endpoint request or empirical long-context test was performed.

modalities.note: Text language-model configuration/checkpoint and API schema support text input/output. The later 2.5-Preview’s new image capability is not transferred to 2.0.

reasoning.note: Explicit multi-step reasoning and thinking control, with reasoning-content fields in the released chat template.

tool_call.note: Final release explicitly supports native tool calls; released template handles tool declarations, tool calls and results.

description.value: Meituan LongCat-2.0 is an open-weight MoE language model with nominal 1.6T total parameters and about 48B activated per token, LongCat Sparse Attention, N-gram embeddings, reasoning and tool calling, and a documented 1,048,576-token API context window.
description.note: Concise technical description replaces the rounded context claim and adds verified nominal architecture/count information without transferring benchmark or successor-model claims.

patch.description: Meituan LongCat-2.0 is an open-weight MoE language model with nominal 1.6T total parameters and about 48B activated per token, LongCat Sparse Attention, N-gram embeddings, reasoning and tool calling, and a documented 1,048,576-token API context window.
patch.notes: Nominal 1.6T parameters; average ~48B active per token (dynamic 33B–56B). Audited BF16/F32 checkpoint 834bf5ffe3047aa9f6cc7a64a9bc068b146b8274 stores 1,775.560491136B elements including separately saved MTP/embedding namespaces; this is not asserted as an exact unique learned count. Documented API context 1,048,576 differs from checkpoint max_position_embeddings 262,144. Final model released 2026-06-30; weights announced 2026-07-06.

sources.label: Official LongCat-2.0 model card and weight license

summary: All 14 fields assessed against exact final-model primary sources. Add MIT license, nominal 1600B total, approximate 48B average active and MoE architecture; correct API context 1,000,000 to 1,048,576. Preserve June 30 final release while distinguishing April 20 preview, July 5 repository creation and July 6 announced weight release. Complete bounded audit of 194 BF16/F32 shard headers reconciles every indexed tensor and explains why 1,775.560491136B serialized elements, duplicated/shared embeddings, MTP and routing adjustments cannot be presented as an exact unique learned count. Source-specific serving/configuration limits are retained; no model inference or full shard download was performed.
